scope: Two-node EP16, 8 L20X/node, SM1620MHz, BF16 H4096/I2048/E256/topK6, inference, no training cache. Kernel timing excludes one-time allocations, GIN context setup/teardown and weight preparation.
communication_scope: Copy-substitution diagnostic only: effective payload GB/s per GPU per direction; bidirectional concurrent traffic, physical ceiling 50GB/s per direction.
comparison: Full GEMM: mean of two independent slowest-rank p50 runs per layout. Copy variants: one 24-sample exploratory run each.
